desc: Howard, in a plaid shirt, puts his arm around Bernadette's shoulder as they smile at each other, while she holds a bottle of water.
Leonard, in a beige jacket, leans over a cluttered workbench, while Raj checks his phone and Howard and Sheldon move in the background.
A shot of Howard touching a spinning contraption  at the office with workbench cluttered with tools and electronic parts.
Sheldon takes his phone out of his pocket at an office with workbench cluttered with tools and electronic parts.
Sheldon falls to the ground while capturing a video of a spinning contraption with his phone.
A blonde woman, in a pink shirt, sits at a small kitchen table, talking on the phone, smiling, and taking notes while looking at her laptop.
Leonard, in a pink shirt, sits on the sofa, reading a wine tasting book with a grimace.
Penny, in dark purple dress, gets her handbag from the armchair and puts it on.
Leonard, in a pink shirt, stands up from the couch and tosses a white book on the table in the living room.
Leonard, in a pink shirt, whips his head around and walks out the door.
Howard slowly walks up to Amy's a wine barrel table at vineyard.
Raj, in a paisley shirt and argyle sweater vest, puts his hands together and bows his head.
Bernadette comes in the door and hands Sheldon a bottle of champagne.
A wide shot of Raj, Leonard, Sheldon, and Amy stand around wine barrel tables, each smelling their wine inside their wine glasses.
A tall man points at Penny's hand at the wine barrel table, so she smiles while she looks at her wedding ring.
A tall man stands between Raj and Penny around the wine barrel and counts with his fingers, while holding a wine glass in his other hand.
Happy Sheldon picks up small train toy, shows it to Bernadette, then puts it back down, while sitting next to each other on the couch.
Bernadette and Sheldon sit on the couch, looking down at several toy trains lined up on the coffee table in front of them, then Bernadette grabs small one.
Sheldon grabs a big toy train while Bernadette holds a small one, sitting on the couch.
A blonde woman walks up to Raj from behind and gives him a kiss on the cheek, at the vineyard.
A shot of Sheldon standing at the kitchen island in front of a row of toast, while Bernadette sits across from him.
Sheldon, in a green shirt, sits on the couch reading from a notebook, holding up a small game figure between his fingers as he talks to Bernadette.
Penny rapidly turns her head and looks strangely at Amy, then nervously takes a drink of wine, while standing at the wine barrel table.
Howard and Leonard stand silently side by side in a men's restroom, in front of a wall-mounted urinal, against a wood-paneled wall.
Howard looks at Leonard while in the bathroom and taps the wall-mounted urinal twice with his fist, while walking away.
Howard, while in the bathroom with Leonard, goes to the sink and washes his hands.
Sheldon shouts excitedly and waves his hand while holding a notebook in it, sitting behind a board game on the coffee table, with Bernadette.
Sheldon, while holding a book, makes a finger gun and points it to his head, then grimaces
Sheldon sweeps his hand across the couch cushion as if brushing away dust, while talking to Bernadette, who sits across from him holding a clipboard.
Amy finishes the rest of her wine in one gulp, then chokes and covers her mouth with her hand, at the table with an appetizers and wine glasses.
A tall man, while standing at the vineyard near Leonard and Raj, makes an OK hand gesture with a wide-eyed, exaggerated expression and his mouth open.
